title: FLA import: Scene 5 imports 2 frames / 'menu' label on frame 2 — should be 1 frame / frame 1
description:
REPRO (Magnet.fla, Scene 5 = OLE2 stream 'Page 5', doc.scenes[1]).

USER REPORT (authoritative vs real Flash 8): Scene 5 main timeline should be 1 FRAME; the Ball-layer frame label 'menu' should sit on frame 1. Our import shows 2 frames and 'menu' on frame 2.

GROUND TRUTH (raw parseFla8Timeline of Page 5):
  Only the 'Ball' layer has 2 CPicFrame records:
    frame[0]: duration=1, label='', script='', elements=0 (EMPTY keyframe), keyMode=0x600
    frame[1]: duration=1, label='menu', script='stop()', elements=3 (Symbol 2 + Symbol 9 + static text), keyMode=0x600
  The other 3 layers (Layer 3, the mask Layer 5, the masked Layer 5) each have exactly 1 CPicFrame.
  So the scene total frame count = max layer span = 2, driven solely by Ball's leading empty frame.

OBSERVED (our import): scene5 Ball layer -> 2 model frames: createFrame(index=0, isEmpty:true) then createFrame(index=1, label='menu', script='stop()'). 'menu' lands at 0-based frame.index===1 (= frame 2 in the 1-based timeline UI). Frame-count and label-offset SHARE ONE ROOT: the leading empty Ball frame.

ROOT CAUSE LOCUS:
- packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts:1291-1386 convertLayer(): emits exactly one model Frame per raw CPicFrame and advances frameIndex += f.duration (line 1376); frameCount = sum of durations (line 1378). It faithfully reproduces whatever readCPicFrameNode returns.
- packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts:2833 readCPicFrameNode() + the CPicLayer children loop (readCPicLayer, line 1312-1314 collects every CPicFrame child of base.children): this is where the count of '2' originates. The leading empty frame[0] is a fully-formed CPicFrame (duration=1, keyMode=0x600), not obvious garbage.

OPEN QUESTION (needs a Flash 8 oracle — flashdrv/Win7 VM — to settle definitively; could not disambiguate from bytes alone in this CODE/DATA pass):
  (a) Flash genuinely authored Ball with an empty keyframe at frame 1 and content at frame 2 (then our import is CORRECT and the user's recollection is the off-by-one) — OR
  (b) the parser is fabricating a PHANTOM leading empty CPicFrame (e.g. the lenient repositionAfterLayerTrailer scan / an extra CPicFrame backref being mis-counted), and Ball truly has ONE keyframe at frame 1 holding the content + 'menu' + stop().
  The user asserts (b)/1-frame. Strong supporting signal: 'menu' + stop() + ALL content live in frame[1]; frame[0] is content-free, which is the signature of a phantom keyframe inserted ahead of the real one.

FIX DIRECTION (described, NOT applied):
- First DISAMBIGUATE with the flashdrv oracle: open Magnet.fla in real Flash 8, read Scene 5 Ball layer frame count + 'menu' label position. (Cannot be guessed.)
- If (b): find where the extra CPicFrame is introduced. Audit readCPicLayer's base.children frame collection (flash8-binary.ts:1312) and repositionAfterLayerTrailer (line 1321+) for a double-read / phantom CPicFrame backref on the Ball layer; the empty frame[0] (duration 1, no elements) is the prime suspect for a spurious leading keyframe. Suppress/merge it so Ball has 1 keyframe -> scene frameCount=1 and 'menu' at frame.index 0.
- If (a): no code fix; instead correct the user-facing expectation and FIX the misleading test below.
- BUG IN EXISTING TEST regardless: packages/core/src/fla/__tests__/magnet-inspect.test.ts 'has menu frame label in Scene 5 at frame 1' asserts frame.index === 1, conflating the 0-based model index 1 with the 1-based UI 'frame 1'. It currently PASSES while the user observes the label on UI frame 2 — i.e. the test codifies the wrong expectation. Re-derive the assertion from the oracle truth (frame.index 0 if 1-frame).

RELATED (NO DEFECT, documented for completeness): the 'ballmask' instance imports CORRECTLY — it is the Symbol 27 MovieClip on the MASK layer ('Layer 5', type=4) frame 0, with instanceName='ballmask' and onClipEvent(load){ tgt=-1; gotoAndPlay('mid') } preserved as a clipActions load handler (verified on tryLoadRealFla(Magnet.fla).scenes[1]). No action needed on ballmask.

NO PRODUCT CODE CHANGED (report+root-cause only). HEAD d678884.
